crossRefs.note: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from…
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like…
Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
“Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you; or thirsty, and give you…
They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as…
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t…
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in…
who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

translations.web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’ ”
translations.bsb: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’”
translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
translations.asv: Even so ye also, when ye shall have done all the things that are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which it was our duty to do.
